systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.platform: SIPAO, INTERPOL's programme financed by the European Union (EUR 52 million cumulated since 2012)
systems.tiers: for Côte d'Ivoire nothing beyond a training of 12 trainers, 26-30 September 2022; regionally, 14 of 16 countries have an operational data centre (DACORE) that collects, centralises and records police data daily, and extension beyond the DACORE in the capital is a 2023 priority; countries not listed
Côte d'Ivoire is one of five countries connected as of December 2022, so SIPAO users can query INTERPOL's global databases from their workstation
Côte d'Ivoire is one of four countries where an existing AFIS is to be restored or upgraded as a priority, by the AFIS project steering committee's recommendation of 21 July 2022

note: INTERPOL's December 2022 newsletter describes SIPAO regionally as data centres that collect, centralise and record police data, and gives regional figures only (nearly 500,000 records; 14 of 16 DACORE operational); it names Côte d'Ivoire for the I-24/7 connection, the AFIS upgrade list, a trainers' course and as host of meetings. Nothing says Ivorian stations enter reports or cases in SIPAO, so it is not classed as record and gives no fact.
